text: Subprocess spawn on Windows: detached:true + unref() is insufficient for orphan prevention when terminal is force-closed. Short-term fix: clear PID file on launcher startup, treat stale cron-session-ping.json as dead (re-launch). Long-term: use windowsHide:true + Windows Job Object attachment.

JSONL queue for cron subprocess: O_EXCL atomic drain via file rename (not in-place rewrite) is required to prevent partial drains. Also implement line-level try/parse with skip-on-error to prevent one corrupted line from halting all queue processing.

stale-task-detector.cjs fires on every UserPromptSubmit with no per-task cooldown. A single zombie task can flood gap-log with 40+ identical entries in one session, crowding out genuine signals. Workaround: Router Step 0.4 stale-tasks.json auto-close prevents accumulation if processed early.

INSERT OR REPLACE in SQLite is DELETE+INSERT — resets ALL unspecified columns to NULL/defaults. NEVER use for task state persistence updates. Use INSERT (create) + UPDATE (transition) or ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE instead. Codex confirmed this risk for A2A task persistence.

Gemini CLI background tasks: when run via background=true, Gemini CLI produces 0 bytes output for 3+ minutes on technical queries. For time-constrained multi-LLM reviews, Codex + direct code verification is more reliable. Use Gemini with sufficient wait time (5+ min) or foreground.

STM consolidateSession() in memory-tiers.cjs has no auto-trigger — must be explicitly called at session boundary. No hook in settings.json fires it automatically. STM content is ephemeral without explicit caller.

heartbeat-orchestrator loop registry (CronCreate IDs) stored only in working memory + CronList — session restart loses all 8 loop registrations. Use writeMemory("heartbeat-loop-registry") to persist across sessions.

CREATOR_GUARD bypass risk: During long EPIC implementation sessions, unified-creator-guard.cjs may be in warn mode. Agents can then directly Edit .claude/skills/**/*.md without going through skill-updater. This bypasses the audit trail. Always verify CREATOR_GUARD=block is active, or check git diff for protected path modifications after session.

reflection-agent dual-task-ID: When router spawns reflection-agent via Task(), TWO task IDs exist: (a) the router Task() task_id and (b) the internal reflection-task-completion-* ID. The atomic handshake only closes (b). Router-level task (a) stays in_progress indefinitely. Fix: spawn prompts must explicitly instruct reflection-agent to call TaskUpdate(completed) on BOTH IDs.

post-completion-chain.cjs fires twice within 14s for devops tasks that git commit immediately after TaskUpdate, producing duplicate_trigger_fallback: second invocation loses task metadata and emits fallback string. Add idempotency guard using taskId deduplication set.

Devops agent cut-off gotcha: devops agents cut off mid-commit when given combined merge+cleanup+commit prompts. Fix: single-purpose devops commands only. Recovery: always resume (not re-spawn) to avoid duplicate commits.

Batch skill creation misses catalog registration: When creating multiple skills in a single wave (Wave 1 of MEGA EVOLUTION), new skills (pptx, xlsx, knowledge-graph) are not automatically added to skill-catalog.md. This creates orphaned skills that are invisible to the Router. Confirmed 3 times (2026-02-14, 2026-03-14, 2026-03-15). Fix: add explicit catalog registration step to Wave 1 plan checklist.

CROSS-REFERENCE: CC auto-memory stores platform gotchas in ~/.claude/projects/.../memory/reference_technical_fixes.md (Windows paths, SQLite EBUSY, hook exit codes). Agent-studio gotchas.json stores operational gotchas. Both systems are canonical for their domain — CC for behavioral guidance, agent-studio for operational patterns. Do not duplicate entries across systems.
